Eve - Album 1: WHO

Encumbered Discoveries

"Every room a question, every answer changing plans"

[Intro]

Morning came But not the same The road was waiting With Grandma’s name

One old key One hidden place One quiet map I had to trace

[Verse 1]

The morning after burial I drove beyond the town Past roads that looked forgotten Where the fields grew wild and brown

The turns grew steep and narrower The trees leaned close and still Then suddenly it stood there Like a secret on the hill

A mansion dressed in shadow Five stories tall and worn No signs of someone living there No sound of anything warm

The windows held their silence The gate had long since rusted The whole place felt abandoned

And somehow still entrusted

[Pre-Chorus]

I held the keys I held my breath I held a thousand questions On the edge of something left

If this was hers Then who was she And why had none of this Been told to me?

[Chorus]

Encumbered discoveries Heavy in my hands Every room a question Every answer changing plans

Encumbered discoveries Dust and locks and light A house that should be empty Still watching me tonight

I came here looking for a past I thought was mine to know

But every door I open Makes the hidden deeper grow

[Verse 2]

I walked the halls in silence Every landing, every floor Five stories full of secrets And each one asking more

Bedrooms dressed in stillness Portraits turned away Furniture with linen ghosts That time forgot to claim

A grand staircase in twilight A dining room gone cold A music room with broken glass And stories never told

Then down below the basement Where the air grew strange and still A single door stood waiting there

Shut against the farthest wall

I tried the keys in order Each one failed the same No metal turned No hinge gave way No plaque revealed a name

[Pre-Chorus]

So I went back up Following dust and dim Till I found the library wing

And something in me changed with it

[Chorus]

Encumbered discoveries Shelves older than the paint Books that looked like diaries Preserved like acts of faith

Encumbered discoveries Bindings cracked with age Names and signs and creatures Spilling from each page

Some I knew from lectures Some I’d never seen before

And all of them were waiting Like they knew what I came for

[Bridge]

There were stories filled with monsters Some familiar, some unknown Some in ink I could decipher Some in languages I don’t

One insignia kept returning Stamped in gold and fading blue Different names beneath the symbol But somehow all of them rang true

Ordo Custodum Velaminis

Another read

La Orden de los Custodios del Velo

And one in English, clear as warning Plain enough for me to read

The Order of the Veilguards

I said it softly to the room Like maybe it would answer me

It didn’t

But the silence changed

[Verse 3]

Then tucked between the journals I found an old photograph My grandmother much younger Before the years I had

No softer silver patience No gentle cardigan and cane But fierce and bright and standing tall Still carrying my face

There were twelve of them behind her Lined in weather, lined in will And there upon the left side Made the whole house suddenly still

A little girl with dolls beside her Maybe six or close to that Red hair like mine in smaller strands

My mother

Laughing at the camera

I smiled before I knew I had Like finding warmth inside the ache But who were all those people And what had Grandma tried to save?

[Final Chorus]

Encumbered discoveries Heavier than before Not just books and hidden rooms But blood behind a door

Encumbered discoveries A picture in my hand A past that started breathing In a way I hadn’t planned

The house was dark The hall was long The silence almost kind

Then somewhere in the corridor I heard a step behind

[Outro]

I turned too fast The photo shook The sound was closer now

Another step Then one more still Enough to end the how

A voice came through the shadow Low and calm and strange

“You finally came.”
